shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak client templates using Keycloak API

options.name: attributes
options.description: A dict of further attributes for this client template. This can contain various configuration settings, though in the default installation of Keycloak as of 3.4, none are documented or known, so this is usually empty.

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect I(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with I(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_keycloak_url
options.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the client template in Keycloak.

options.name: full_scope_allowed
options.description: Is the "Full Scope Allowed" feature set for this client template or not. This is C(fullScopeAllowed) in the Keycloak REST API.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of client template to be worked on. This is usually a UUID.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the client template.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Type of client template. The V(docker-v2) value was added in middleware_automation.keycloak 8.6.0.

options.name: protocol_mappers
options.description: A list of dicts defining protocol mappers for this client template. This is C(protocolMappers) in the Keycloak REST API.

options.name: realm
options.description: Realm this client template is found in.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the client template. On V(present), the client template is created (or updated if it exists already). On V(absent), the client template is removed if it exists.

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
